Globex Vulnerability Disclosure Policy

Globex welcomes reports from security researchers. Please report any security vulnerability to security@globex.com. We will respond within 5 business days.

We operate under safe harbor. We will not pursue legal action against researchers acting in good faith. We do not offer monetary rewards, but we maintain a hall of fame.

In Scope

  • www.globex.com
  • portal.globex.com

Out of Scope

  • Social engineering

Rules of engagement

Please do not perform denial of service testing.

We also run a private program on HackerOne.
